WITH molecule_flags AS (
    
    SELECT
        m."molecule_id",
        MAX(CASE WHEN m."label" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_carcinogenic
    FROM "molecule" m
    GROUP BY m."molecule_id"
),
molecule_chlorine AS (
    
    SELECT
        a."molecule_id",
        MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(a."element") = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_chlorine
    FROM "atom" a
    GROUP BY a."molecule_id"
)
SELECT
    
    (SUM(CASE WHEN mf.is_carcinogenic = 1 AND mc.has_chlorine = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(mf."molecule_id")::numeric) * 100 AS percentage
FROM molecule_flags mf
LEFT JOIN molecule_chlorine mc
    ON mf."molecule_id" = mc."molecule_id";

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "badges"
    WHERE "name" = 'Student'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2010, 2011)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP))
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN cnt END), 0) AS cnt_2010,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2011 THEN cnt END), 0) AS cnt_2011,
        SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt
    FROM yearly_counts
)

SELECT
    cnt_2010,
    cnt_2011,
    total_cnt,
    (cnt_2010::numeric / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) * 100)
    - (cnt_2011::numeric / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM totals;

1451:
WITH member_event_expenses AS (
    SELECT
        e."link_to_member" AS member_id,
        b."link_to_event" AS event_id,
        SUM(e."cost") AS total_cost
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE e."link_to_member" IS NOT NULL
      AND b."link_to_event" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member", b."link_to_event"
),

multi_event_members AS (
    SELECT member_id
    FROM member_event_expenses
    GROUP BY member_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) > 1
),

member_totals AS (
    SELECT
        mee.member_id,
        SUM(mee.total_cost) AS total_paid
    FROM member_event_expenses mee
    JOIN multi_event_members mem ON mee.member_id = mem.member_id
    GROUP BY mee.member_id
)

SELECT
    m."member_id",
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    mt.total_paid
FROM member_totals mt
JOIN "member" m ON mt.member_id = m."member_id"
ORDER BY mt.total_paid DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
